ready2_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $ax^{2}-x+b\geq 0$ with respect to $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $bx^{2}-x+a\leq 0$ with respect to $x$.
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $ax^{2}-x+b\geq 0$ with respect to $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $bx^{2}-x+a\leq 0$ with respect to $x$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem statement: the solution set of the inequality ax^2-x+b≥0 with respect to x is [-2,1]. Because the zeros of this quadratic expression are exactly the endpoints of the solution set, -2 and 1, we can set ax^2-x+b = k(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives k(x^2+x-2)=kx^2+kx-2k. Comparing the coefficient of the x term with ax^2-x+b gives k=-1, therefore a=k=-1, b=-2k=2. Substituting a=-1 and b=2 into the second inequality bx^2-x+a≤0 gives 2x^2-x-1≤0. Factorization: 2x^2-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1), so (2x+1)(x-1)≤0. This quadratic function opens upward, and the solution of ≤0 is between the two roots; the roots are x=-1/2 and x=1, therefore the solution set is [-1/2,1].

raw_record.question_text: It is known that the solution set of the inequality $ax^{2}-x+b\geq 0$ with respect to $x$ is $[-2,1]$; find the solution set of the inequality $bx^{2}-x+a\leq 0$ with respect to $x$.

method.method_draft: 从题面读取第一个不等式 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集为 [-2,1]。由于解集端点是二次式的两个零点，可把 ax^2-x+b 写成 k(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 kx^2+kx-2k，与 ax^2-x+b 比较 x 项系数，得 k=-1，因此 a=-1，b=2。再代入第二个不等式 bx^2-x+a≤0，化为 2x^2-x-1≤0，因式分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0，得到解集 [-1/2,1]。
method.CoT_raw: 从题面读取：关于 x 的不等式 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集为 [-2,1]。因为该二次式的零点就是解集端点 -2 和 1，所以可设 ax^2-x+b = k(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 k(x^2+x-2)=kx^2+kx-2k。与 ax^2-x+b 比较 x 项系数，得到 k=-1，因此 a=k=-1，b=-2k=2。将 a=-1、b=2 代入第二个不等式 bx^2-x+a≤0，得 2x^2-x-1≤0。因式分解：2x^2-x-1=(2x+1)(x-1)，所以 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0。该二次函数开口向上，≤0 的解在两个根之间，根为 x=-1/2 和 x=1，因此解集为 [-1/2,1]。

method.method_draft: 从题面读取 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集为 [-2,1]，因此 x=-2 与 x=1 是方程 ax^2-x+b=0 的两个根。分别代入：4a+2+b=0，a-1+b=0。联立解得 a=-1，b=2；同时 a<0 与 ≥0 的解集为两根之间相符。再把 a,b 代入 bx^2-x+a≤0，得到 2x^2-x-1≤0。用求根公式求根：x=(1±3)/4，即 -1/2 和 1。由于二次项系数 2>0，不等式 ≤0 的解集在两根之间，所以为 [-1/2,1]。
method.CoT_raw: 从题面可知，不等式 ax^2 - x + b ≥ 0 的解集为 [-2,1]，所以 x = -2 和 x = 1 是方程 ax^2 - x + b = 0 的两个根。分别代入：当 x = -2 时，4a + 2 + b = 0；当 x = 1 时，a - 1 + b = 0。联立两式，得 a = -1，b = 2。将 a = -1，b = 2 代入 bx^2 - x + a ≤ 0，得到 2x^2 - x - 1 ≤ 0。解方程 2x^2 - x - 1 = 0，得 x = (1 ± 3)/4，所以两根为 -1/2 和 1。由于二次项系数 2 > 0，抛物线开口向上，不等式 ≤ 0 的解集在两根之间，因此解集为 [-1/2,1]。
